value.rationale: An infinite, previously studied natural convex-geometry family is Sauer-maximum yet has online dimension asymptotically just 1/(k+1) of its log-cardinality (for fixed k), separating extremal static richness from adaptive depth. Exact first eight k=1 depth thresholds identify a nontrivial online growth staircase, not merely a restatement of the concept count.
